metadata.purpose: Smoke tests to verify skill core functionality

tests.name: Sofia Coppola + BJJ One-on-One (Slow Contemplative)

input.special_requirements: breathing emphasis, long holds, slow-motion on impact

expected_outputs: Must include timing chart with 0.1s precision
Average shot duration 2-3s minimum (Coppola's pacing)
Impact holds 0.4-0.5s (extended, not standard 0.2s)
Pastel-tinted desaturation mentioned in color treatment
Shallow depth-of-field with soft focus background
Breathing audible and synchronized
BJJ leverage emphasis (not punching/kicking)
Prompt under 2000 tokens
Timing chart sums to exactly 8 seconds
Certification checklist confirms all requirements
validation_rules: Director-martial art matrix lookup successful (Coppola + BJJ marked as 'natural pairing')
High-speed compensation strategy: slow push-in or static hold selected
Static shots forbid drift explicitly
All actions describe observable behavior (muscle strain, breathing pattern, grip pressure visible)
No rapid cutting (0.3-0.5s cuts inappropriate for Coppola)
Color palette (pastel desaturated) evident throughout

tests.name: Kathryn Bigelow + HK Kung Fu Multi-Opponent (Handheld Rapid)

input.special_requirements: rapid cutting, close-ups on faces, opponent variety

expected_outputs: Must include timing chart with multiple opponent phases
Shot duration 0.4-1.0s (Bigelow's tight cutting)
Handheld camera with micro-wobble (2-4 Hz) throughout
Close-ups on hero's face showing focus/determination
Rapid opponent entrances (0.4-0.6s per opponent)
High-contrast desaturated environment (focus on faces)
Impact sounds layered and distinct (different frequencies per opponent)
Prompt under 2000 tokens despite 12s duration
Timing chart sums to exactly 12 seconds
4-5 opponents clearly distinguished in choreography
validation_rules: Director-martial art pairing optimal (Bigelow + HK confirmed)
High-speed compensation: rapid cutting (Bigelow rule) applied
Handheld micro-wobble (not smooth tracking) throughout
Average shot duration 0.5-0.8s (Bigelow fast-paced)
Impact holds 0.15-0.2s (quick confirmation, not contemplative)
All cuts timestamped to 0.1s precision
Hero's position clear (not lost in handheld chaos)
Each opponent impact has distinct frequency tag

tests.name: Park Chan-wook + Sword Fighting (Baroque Saturated)

input.special_requirements: red accent colors, slow-motion on rotation, metallic reflections

expected_outputs: Must include full 15-second timing chart with blade-by-blade detail
Saturated colors (85%+ saturation) evident in description
Red accent colors on blade contact/blood moments
Slow lateral camera tracking (baroque motion) emphasized
Shot duration 2-3s minimum (Park's composed style)
Slow-motion on rotational strikes (0.6x speed)
Metallic reflections key to visual interest
Geometric framing (thirds, diagonals) documented
Prompt under 2000 tokens despite complexity
Timing chart sums to exactly 15 seconds
validation_rules: Director-martial art pairing strong (Park + sword confirmed optimal)
High-speed compensation: slow push-in during engagement + arc tracking
Slow lateral tracking (40-60% of blade speed) evident in camera strategy
Color saturation tags (85%+) for all martial artist/weapon descriptions
Slow-motion timing clear (0.6x speed, X-second holds)
Geometric framing language used (diagonals, thirds, z-axis depth)
Blade geometry emphasized (extension lines, point-to-point clarity)
Rain/mist for light reflection enhancement documented

tests.name: Template Mode: One-on-One Duel (Adaptation Test)

input.special_adaptations: wide landscape context, minimal close-ups, patient pacing

expected_outputs: Must use one-on-one-duel template (approach, exchange, impact, reset, escalation, climax)
Adapt template to Denis Villeneuve style (wider shots, landscape context)
Timing chart modified from standard (longer landscape holds)
Average shot duration 2-3s (Villeneuve patient)
Very wide establishing shots (15m+) showing rooftop environment
Slow push-in during engagement (standard Villeneuve)
Deep depth-of-field showing multiple environment layers
Minimal close-ups (only impact moments)
Prompt under 2000 tokens
Timing chart sums to exactly 10 seconds
validation_rules: Template lookup successful (one_on_one_duel template loaded)
Director adaptation clear (Villeneuve's style applied to template beats)
Wide establishing shots 2-3s each (vs typical template 1.5s)
Landscape prominence evident (rooftop, sky, urban context visible)
Geometric positioning emphasized (distance, sight lines)
Patient pacing (no rapid cuts, no handheld urgency)
Deep depth-of-field consistently applied
Climax beat outside final 10% (confirmed in timing)

tests.name: Director Study Mode: Greta Gerwig + Environmental Combat

input.question: How would Greta Gerwig shoot a 10-second environmental combat scene with HK kung fu choreography?

expected_outputs: Must include full director study analysis
Explain Gerwig's approach to action (choreography, musical rhythm, playful energy)
Show HK kung fu adaptations for Gerwig (slower cuts, grace emphasis, whimsy despite danger)
Provide reference prompt ready to use
Color palette (saturated, playful) documented
Musical integration (cuts on beat, rhythm synchronized)
Slow-motion on environmental strikes (0.6x speed)
Playful tone evident despite high-impact choreography
Timing chart provided for reference
Prompt under 2000 tokens
validation_rules: Director-martial art matrix consulted (Gerwig + HK identified)
Gerwig's style characteristics documented (whimsy, choreography, music)
HK kung fu pacing adapted (slower than standard, grace-focused)
Color saturation tags (playful palette)
Musical rhythm integration documented
Slow-motion strategy clear (0.6x on arcs)
Choreography emphasized as 'dance-like' (Gerwig characteristic)
Environmental objects treated as props/partners not weapons
Analysis readable and educational (learning outcome achieved)

core_functionality: Skill accepts action_type, duration, director_style, scene_type inputs ✓
Skill outputs MiniMax H3 prompt (Task type + Shots + descriptions) ✓
Skill applies director style to pacing (not just color grading) ✓
Skill applies martial art pacing (BJJ ≠ HK in timing) ✓
Skill forbids drift in static shots (explicitly stated) ✓
Skill converts actions to observable behavior ✓
reference_integration: Action scene templates adapted (if template mode) ✓
mode_specific: Quick Mode: Single prompt output in <2 minutes ✓
Detailed Mode: Timing chart + analysis in 5-10 minutes ✓
Template Mode: Template loaded + adapted + prompt ✓
Director Study Mode: Full analysis + educational ✓
error_prevention: Timing chart sums to target duration (no overage) ✓
Climax beat outside final 10% of clip ✓
Director style evident throughout (not just mentioned) ✓
Prompt ready to paste into MiniMax H3 (correct syntax) ✓

known_limitations: Skill works best with 8-12s durations (5-15s range supported, but middle is optimal)
Director-martial art matrix covers 14 directors × 7 martial arts = 98 combinations (some may require extrapolation)
Prompts assume MiniMax H3 syntax (may need adaptation for other models)
High-speed compensation strategies most effective for martial arts, less so for other action
Audio design templates assume diegetic/impact-focused sounds (music-heavy scenes may need revision)
Template adaptation works best when template + director + martial art fit the matrix
future_enhancements: Add weapon-specific templates (gun action, knife combat)
Expand director database (10+ more contemporary directors)
Add stunt-coordination emphasis mode (for integration with stunt teams)
Multi-language reference materials (French, Chinese, Korean, Japanese)
Video example links (reference actual films for each director-martial art combo)
Integration with MiniMax H3 API (direct generation from prompt)
Batch mode (generate multiple 10s scenes for longer sequences)
Audio design detail library (library of punch/kick/block sounds by martial art)
